verdict.rationale: Sentry documents natural-language questioning of telemetry through Seer Agent, which "finds the right telemetry to answer it." Its official MCP server also lets AI assistants search errors and analyze performance. The evidence never shows the output being a real, inspectable query or a generated chart, so only half the story is covered. Missing for 10: evidence that natural-language questions return an actual query or chart/dashboard widget, depth docs on the NL query feature, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask questions of my telemetry in natural language and get a real query or chart back

citations.quote: Ask any question about your application and Seer Agent finds the right telemetry to answer it.
Connects AI assistants to Sentry for searching errors, analyzing performance, triaging issues, reading documentation, and managing projects
